Your strengths and qualifications:

 * You have 3+ years proven experience in e-commerce management, with a track record of delivering measurable growth.

 * Experience in Food & Beverage, consumer goods, lifestyle, health & wellness, or similar industries is a plus.

 * Fluent English is a must. German, French or another European language is a strong plus.

 * You are analytically driven, including working knowledge of analytic tools.

 * You excel at managing multiple projects simultaneously, with strong attention to detail.

 * You're proactive, solution-oriented, and quick to adapt in a fast-paced environment.

 * You excel in cross-functional collaboration and communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders.

 * You stay ahead of e-commerce innovations, tools, and technologies.

 * Experience with Shopify strongly preferred.

What we offer you:

 * A high-achieving, international community of waterdrop® colleagues, located in a brand-new HQ in Vienna, Austria.

 * MyClubs sports vouchers, to have a sporty balance.

 * In-house fitness centre. 

 * In-house company doctor & Instahelp vouchers.

 * Subsidized healthy meals, for a break with your colleagues.

 * Discount on your waterdrop purchases.

 * Coverage of your transportation card.

 * Legendary summer and Christmas parties!

The annual gross salary for this position is around EUR 50.000 on a full-time basis (All-in). The final salary will depend on your qualifications and professional experience. Depending on your qualifications, there is the willingness for overpayment.

1 DESIGNATED SAFEGUARDING LEAD (m/w/d) Your core responsibilities

 * Strategic Safeguarding Leadership: Lead and continuously strengthen the school-wide safeguarding and child protection framework, policies, procedures, and culture.
 * Safeguarding Coordination & Case Management: Act as the senior point of coordination and escalation, ensuring concerns are appropriately assessed, documented, referred, and followed up in a timely, child-centered manner.
 * Leadership Advice & Governance: Advise school leadership, counsellors, HR, and relevant staff on safeguarding thresholds, actions, allegations, and governance reporting while maintaining confidentiality.
 * Training, Prevention & Safer Recruitment: Build safeguarding capacity through staff training, practical guidance, safer recruitment, induction, codes of conduct, and effective management of concerns involving adults.
 * External Partnerships & Records Management: Maintain strong relationships with Austrian child and youth welfare services, authorities, and specialist providers, while ensuring secure, accurate, and compliant safeguarding records.

Your profile

 * Qualifications: Degree in social work, psychology, child protection, safeguarding, child development, youth welfare, counselling, public health, or a related field, with relevant safeguarding and case management training.
 * Experience: Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in child protection, safeguarding, social services, youth welfare, or school wellbeing, including complex case management and safeguarding leadership.
 * Knowledge: Strong understanding of child protection, safeguarding, trauma, abuse, online harm, safer recruitment, data protection, and Austrian child and youth welfare pathways.
 * Languages: Excellent English and basic German, with the ability to communicate effectively with Austrian authorities and understand official documentation.
 * Mindset: Discreet, emotionally mature, and child-centered, with sound judgement, strong communication skills, and the ability to manage sensitive cases and competing priorities in a multicultural environment.

What we offer

 * Purpose & Impact: A meaningful, high-level role where your work directly safeguards a diverse, values-driven educational community.
 * Work-Life Integration: A welcoming, stable, and highly professional school environment that offers a sustainable alternative to traditional billable-hour corporate cultures.
 * Attractive Compensation: Attractive salary classified under Employment Group F of the collective agreement (KV für Angestellte im Handel), featuring a standard 30% school-specific overpayment (starting at a minimum of € 52,402.00 up to € 77,252.00 annual gross salary, with higher placement based on relevant years of experience).
 * Holiday entitlement: 30 days annual leave + 4 additional all-staff school holidays
 * Additional Benefits: 5% company top-up pension contribution, continuous professional development opportunities, and state-of-the-art campus facilities.

As part of our Industrial Digitalization team within Electrics & Automation, you will develop innovative sensor and automation solutions that make metallurgical processes more transparent, efficient, and data-driven. You will be the technical owner of sensor and automation solutions, guiding them from concept and development through commissioning, customer support, and continuous improvement.

If you are passionate about software development and sensor technologies and have a talent for solving complex problems, join our team and take on the following responsibilities:

 

Engineering & Product Ownership

 * Develop innovative sensor and automation solutions for metallurgical processes.
 * Take responsibility for the complete product lifecycle, from hardware selection and software development through commissioning and customer support at customer sites worldwide
 * Design and implement software components using object-oriented programming principles and C++.
 * Support the acquisition, processing, and utilization of sensor data for industrial applications.
 * Work closely with experts from engineering, data analytics, and process technology to create integrated digital solutions.
 * Contribute to the development of new products and technologies within our Industrial Digitalization portfolio.

 

Technical Expert Activities

 * Create technical documentation, operating manuals, and training materials, and deliver customer training to support successful solution adoption.
 * Act as a technical expert throughout the sales process by supporting customer engagements and contributing to solution concepts, technical specifications, and proposal development.
 * Share technical expertise and content for presentations, demonstrations, and other marketing activities.

What do I need to qualify for this job?

 * Completed technical education (FH, University, or equivalent) in Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Science, or a related field.
 * Solid knowledge of object-oriented programming concepts and practical experience with C++.
 * Practical experience with prototyping, automation, data processing, or related technical applications.
 * Strong interest in combining software development with industrial applications and sensor technologies.
 * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 * Ability and willingness to explain complex technical concepts to customers, operators, and internal stakeholders through documentation, training, and technical discussions.
 * Fluent German and English communication skills, both written and spoken.

 

Nice to have

 * Experience with sensor technologies  with 2D and/or 3D image processing  in industrial automation environments.
 * Knowledge of signal processing.
 * Pracical experience in working directly with customers in technical project, commissioning, or support environments.

 

You are interested in having considerable freedom of design, work solution- and results-oriented and you love working in a team? Then we look forward to receiving your application!
